mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, avatar, email, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, last_login_time AS lastLoginTime, version FROM t_user WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password, phone, avatar, email, status, create_time, update_time, last_login_time, version) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{lastLoginTime}, #{version})
